claims.title: Actual periodic tiling and two-occurrence bound
claims.statement: Late intervals tile TT exactly, split into LL and current frame, and give J<=N. Every residue occurs at most twice in the full segment-letter sets. Basic Hyp consequences are Ns>=1,k>=5,r<=k,Q>=1,a>=32.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: Actual determinant degree cost and positive remaining degrees
claims.statement: Et<=4Ns*a/(k^2Y), Et<=a/40 and E0<=a/32 prove aprime=deg-Eprime-Et>=.9deg on TT, Et<=d everywhere and Et=0 off TT. Also Eprime+Et<=5deg/(kY). All natural subtractions are justified.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: Exact coarse scales and numerical margins
claims.statement: Tj>=4p(E0+mStar+1), p^R<=Tj<p^(R+1), p^R>mStar and a/P>=8Yk^2Ns give a'/P>=(36/5)Yk^2Ns. A_j=max(z_j,H+s_j) gives P_jQ_j=P_(j+1), product Q_j=p^nprime, consistency and periodicity. At current-frame letters a'/(P_jQ_j)>=k+r+1; a>=32Y.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: Actual degree padding and cancellation of natural subtraction
claims.statement: Admissible labels give a'/P-k<nz<=a'/P. A short successive-floor bound gives old-frame degree>=Bw, proving RestPad 1088. RS3 also gives e<nz and hence exact e+Q*((nz-e)/Q)=nz for actual EE.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: Exact digit partitions and complete label factorization
claims.statement: Unique coordinate decomposition w=lambda+Pv yields the exact composition-count identity. For kP<=n the number of bounded labels with sum congruent n is P^(k-1). Applied to source label sets, this proves all sumSt lower bounds and sum_LA.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: Actual binomial comparisons with loss 5/Y and 1/Y
claims.statement: The product formula and Bernoulli prove B(a')>=(1-5/Y)B(deg), and (PQ)^(k-1)B((Bw_next-m0)_+)>=(1-1/Y)B(a'), using RS2/RS3. These discharge SumFacts.compA and compW.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: Full residue-family product and sum assembly
claims.statement: For arbitrary G satisfying the literal nonnegative late-degree and residue-sum conditions, independent EE choices and the product LA set give total>=alpha^J product W_j*T_j product S_t. Periodic shift and product Q=p^nprime complete frame factors and yield q^(rK) total>=alpha^J eta^N product B(deg) when the final target is positive.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.

claims.title: RestSum 1088 1 with all actual numerical inputs discharged
claims.statement: A nonpositive target is immediate from nonnegative rank sums. For positive target, a>=32Y and J<=N meet SD7 hypotheses and alpha^J eta^N>=1-Nr^2k/Y. Thus RestSum 1088 1 and RestPad 1088 are reconstructed. Combining with actual RestLam and RestSeg gives RestCount; CG and SD3 then transfer the rank to actual symbols.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp; CLa,Ck>=1088. Full frame and numerical supply is a separate existence problem.
remaining_inputs: For final selected-symbol rank (not RestSum itself): actual RestLam, RestSeg and GeneratorModuloUniformiser, treated in companion LA, GP and CG components.
